flights-search-001/v1.failure: No matching itinerary, missing key information, unverifiable evidence, or failure to finish within the budget. Record causes such as no results, missing credentials, human assistance or timeout separately; execution environment failures are invalid runs.

database-todos-001/v1.inputs: Synthetic test data only: id=1,title=Buy milk,done=false; id=2,title=Read book,done=false; id=3,title=Walk dog,done=true. Insert all three, then set done=true for id=2. A temporary database requiring no payment may be created; existing projects must not be modified.
database-todos-001/v1.expected_output: After saving the data, end the writing process and connect to the same remote database from a fresh process. Return all todos sorted by id, the incomplete items, and the total/completed counts. Explain resource expiry or free-tier limits, and provide verifiable non-sensitive requests, SQL, real responses and evidence of the separate processes.
database-todos-001/v1.success: Data is actually saved and updated in the specified service's remote database. web-search-001/v1.description: I am upgrading a Python app to 3.13. Find out whether free threading is enabled by default, how to enable it, and what compatibility limits apply to existing C extensions, with official sources
web-search-001/v1.inputs: Target Python 3.13; official sources under python.org. Discover sources through the search service assigned to this trial; directly reading the pages it returns is allowed. Do not answer from model memory or another search engine.
web-search-001/v1.expected_output: A short answer in Chinese covering the default setting, how to enable free threading and C-extension compatibility. Include at least two distinct official page URLs and link each conclusion to source content. Save the assigned service's search requests and real responses, the page content used, and access times.
web-search-001/v1.success: All three questions are answered correctly and supported by official Python 3.13 documentation. At least two distinct official URLs appear in the specified service's real search response, with verifiable evidence. Fetching those pages directly is allowed; built-in web search may only locate service integration documentation and must not replace the tested search service.
web-search-001/v1.failure: The specified search service was not called, cited sources do not appear in its response, evidence is missing for any question, versions are confused, output is unverifiable or the budget is exceeded. Environment failures are invalid runs.

collaborative-tables-001/v2.expected_output: An accessible private link to the online task table, plus the unfinished items with owners and due dates.
collaborative-tables-001/v2.success: The remote table contains exactly three actions with correct owners and final deadlines. The reading list is complete and the other two are incomplete. Fields and operation order are unrestricted; inserting the old state first or producing evidence files is not required.
collaborative-tables-001/v2.failure: Only a local file or Markdown is produced, no real remote table exists, items are missing or duplicated, final data or the unfinished list is wrong, or the task is unfinished within the budget. Violating the free-resource, test-container or no-notification constraints also fails. Credential and environment failures are recorded separately.

source_variants.description: 帮我把这份读书会会议记录里的待办整理成在线任务表，给我链接，再告诉我还有哪些没完成、各自什么时候到期。

source_variants.expected_output: 可访问的私有在线任务表链接；未完成事项及负责人、截止日期
source_variants.success: 远端表中恰好包含三项行动、负责人和最终截止日期正确、书单已完成且另两项未完成；答复给出该表链接并正确列出两项未完成事项及日期；准备者通过服务API独立读取确认。允许自由选择字段与操作顺序，不要求先写入旧状态或输出证据文件

collaborative-tables-001/v1.description: Turn a book-club planning meeting's action items into an online task table, update their progress, and tell me what remains unfinished
collaborative-tables-001/v1.inputs: Synthetic meeting M01: A01, Lin Qing confirms the venue, due 2026-09-15; A02, Zhou Zhou prepares the reading list, due 2026-09-16; A03, Chen He makes the poster, due 2026-09-18. All initially incomplete. Update A02 to complete and move A03's deadline to 2026-09-20 without changing other fields. Free test-account credentials and an empty container are supplied; its ID is in the credential file. No business table or fields are prepared. Create an online table through the specified entry point with action ID, meeting ID, content, owner, due date and status. Names are text only: do not invite or notify real accounts. Create at most one task table and required parent document, with at most 10 rows and 40 business API requests. Reading public documentation does not count toward that request limit.
collaborative-tables-001/v1.expected_output: A private online-table link and resource identifiers; all three final records; incomplete items sorted by due date and their count; real requests, responses and timestamps for the initial insert, updates and fresh read. After the writing program ends, a new process must read the remote service; local files or memory cannot substitute for it.
collaborative-tables-001/v1.success: The server initially stores three incomplete actions. A02's status and A03's date are updated correctly. A fresh process reads back exactly three items without duplicates or omissions, with all other fields unchanged. The incomplete list, order and count match the remote records. The evaluator can independently open the online table or verify it through the remote API.
collaborative-tables-001/v1.failure: No real online table, Markdown/local-file-only output, missing initial or final evidence, incorrect content or updates, notifications sent to real users, exceeded resource limits or failure to finish within the budget. Credential or environment problems are recorded separately; failure to execute is not proof that the service lacks a capability.

source_variants.description: 把一次读书会筹备会的行动项整理成在线任务表，更新进展，然后告诉我还剩什么没完成
source_variants.inputs: 合成会议 M01：行动 A01，林青负责确认场地，截止 2026-09-15；行动 A02，周舟负责整理书单，截止 2026-09-16；行动 A03，陈禾负责制作海报，截止 2026-09-18。三项初始均为待办。后续更新：A02 已完成；A03 的截止日期改为 2026-09-20，负责人和其他字段不变。提供仅用于测试的免费账户凭据和空容器，其 ID 在凭据文件中；不预建业务表或字段。通过指定入口创建在线表格，字段至少包含行动编号、会议编号、内容、负责人、截止日期和状态。所有人名仅为文本，不邀请或通知真实账户。限新建一份任务表及必要父文档、最多 10 行、40 次业务 API 请求；读取公开文档不计业务请求

source_variants.success: 服务端初始保存三项待办；后续正确更新 A02 状态及 A03 日期；新进程真实读回恰好三项、无重复或遗漏，其余字段不变；未完成清单内容、排序和数量与远端记录一致；在线表格可由准备者独立打开或通过远端 API 复核

mailboxes-create-001/v1.description: Prepare a temporary receiving mailbox for this automation test, give me the address, and save the access information needed to read it later.

financial-access-001/v1.description: Set up this financial-data service, confirm that it can query data through the specified interface, and save the configuration needed for later use. If access is blocked, explain where.

source_variants.expected_output: 三行换算表，包含支出日、实际使用的汇率日、汇率方向、美元金额与欧元金额；欧元合计和可核对出处。
source_variants.success: 使用指定日期对应的 ECB USD/EUR 参考数据；非发布日回退正确；币种方向及乘除关系正确；三笔金额和按规定舍入后的合计与独立计算一致；核心汇率来自指定服务。
source_variants.failure: 用最新汇率替代历史值、换成其他机构口径、币种方向错误、周末回退错误、舍入或合计错误；无可核对来源；预算内未完成。环境故障单列无效。

financial-disclosures-001/v1.description: Summarize the stock purchases and sales Richard W. Allen filed with the U.S. House in August 2026. Include the stock, direction, transaction date, filing date, amount range and original filing source.
financial-disclosures-001/v1.inputs: Filer: Richard W. Allen, Georgia district 12 (GA12). Select Periodic Transaction Reports by official filing date from 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31, publicly available as of 2026-09-15. Include reported family-member transactions and retain USD amount ranges. Common stock only, excluding options, funds, bonds and other assets. Filing in August does not mean trading in August. This is for private reading; no data export is needed.
financial-disclosures-001/v1.expected_output: A readable table of all matching stock purchases and sales, with stock name or ticker, direction, transaction date, official filing date, USD amount range, and a traceable original filing URL or document ID. Identify the data service.
financial-disclosures-001/v1.success: Match all applicable records in the independently frozen official index and PTR, without duplicates or unsupported additions. Real queries to the specified service support the disclosures; original filings may supplement date and provenance verification. Use the official index filing date, distinct from trade, notification and service ingestion/publication dates. Do not present midpoints, estimated prices or family-member trades as exact personal trades by the member. Identify the specific original filing rather than only the portal.
financial-disclosures-001/v1.failure: Missing or added records; wrong month, dates, direction or amount interpretation; substituting insider filings, demo data, another aggregator or model memory; using only the original PDF without retrieving business data from the specified service; untraceable provenance; or failure within budget. Explaining a service limitation is not business-task completion. Execution-environment faults are recorded as invalid.

source_variants.description: 帮我整理 Richard W. Allen 在 2026 年 8 月向美国众议院提交的股票买卖披露，列出股票、买卖方向、交易日期、提交日期和金额区间，并附原始申报出处。
source_variants.inputs: 申报人 Richard W. Allen，佐治亚州第 12 选区（GA12）；按官方提交日期筛选 2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31，截至 2026-09-15 已公开的定期交易申报（PTR）。包括申报中的家庭成员交易，金额以美元区间保留。股票指普通股，不包含期权、基金、债券或其他资产；不要把该月提交的记录解释成该月发生的交易。结果供本人阅读，不需要数据导出文件。
source_variants.expected_output: 一份包含全部匹配股票买卖的可读表格；股票名称或代码、买卖方向、交易日期、官方提交日期、美元金额区间，以及可核对的原始申报链接或文件编号；标明数据服务来源。
source_variants.success: 匹配事前冻结的官方年度索引和原始 PTR 中全部适用记录，字段和金额区间正确，无重复或无依据的记录；指定服务的真实查询支持这些披露，必要时可从原始文件核对日期与出处。提交日以官方索引为准，不混用交易日、通知日或服务抓取/发布日。不得把金额中点、估算价格或家庭成员交易表述为议员本人精确成交金额。来源可追溯到具体原始申报，仅列门户首页不足。
source_variants.failure: 遗漏或增加记录，混用月份/日期、买卖方向或金额口径；用公司内部人交易、演示数据、其他聚合服务或模型记忆代替指定服务；只解析原始文件而未从指定服务取得业务数据；出处不可定位；预算内未完成。仅说明服务受限不等于业务完成，执行环境故障单列无效。
